It finally was Friday, today was the day me and friends were planning to trip balls. Ill prepared for what was to come but did not care. 15 tabs were calling our names and that's all that ran through our minds.
We took the first two tabs at around 4PM. We put on a few movies and talked for a good while. An hour and a half goes by and I started to feel the onset of the tabs, sleepy almost a dreamy feeling, yet nothing too extraordinary. My friends start to think it isn't working, so they take an extra two more tabs each. Another 30 minutes go by and I am full on tripping, the feeling of self awareness inflicts me. Like a smack to the face by the beauty and the miracles around me. My friends are way over their heads, they are tripping massive balls for their first time. We watch Eminem music videos and laugh about how they actually make sense, appalled and amazed. Two hours in I am at my peak and felt insecure about small things, I go to the restroom and sit down, to try to make sense of why I am feeling this way instead of enjoying it. I watch the walls melt and the colors change. I then rejoins friends who have now gone decided to get munchies. First I take a 10mg Valium, to relieve any anxiety.
As a group we journey down the hallway to the kitchen. Finally making it to the kitchen I decide that another tab would be an excellent idea. While my friends attempt at eating, we manage our way back to the bedroom to watch a light show on the TV. As I sat there, in the dark with only the light show playing, I started seeing other beings of light and beauty. There were four of them and they were not scary, but interesting. I watched them for a awhile then turned on the lights to see if they would be there, only to be amused when mojo-jojo appeared. After watching the light show for the remaining of the trip, we took the rest of the Valium, I took 10mg. I stayed up with one friend, while the other passed out. I was at some points very tired and other points awake as can be.
I then decided to go shoot up the rest of my black tar heroin, cooking up small amounts, being very cautious, never having combined the mixture of these drugs. I got the syringe ready, yet I was still tripping, after 8 hours from taking the last dose. I  then looked down at the expanding and shrinking veins and found it difficult to shoot up, yet still managed to. A little relief, yet still I did not feel the desired effect, the heroin felt impotent, which it was most definitely not. After waiting some more I then decided to shoot the rest. All while battling the question 'Why would one do this to themselves'.
Somewhere in the mix of the combination the heroin did not have any real high to it, yet after an hour and a half I finally got to sleep.  I would say the overall experience was awesome. If I could change anything it would be to be more prepared and not to IV anything.
